title: Shippori Mincho
description: A Japanese mincho that leans display. A representative mincho tone for literary, cinematic, and Japanese-style scenes. The Regular binary is already bundled at assets/font/shippori-mincho/ in this repo (added 2026-08-03. The catalog side stays an index, and source below is the fetch record).
when_to_use: Captions for a cinematic, Japanese-style, or emotional decisive line
ai_usage: ウェイトは用途に応じて選び分けてよい。字間・行間・カラーは overlay/テロップ側で調整してよいが、グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
